119: class MemoryConfig:
120:     """Configuration for memory handler.
121: 
122:     Qdrant connection fields default to values read from ``HEADROOM_QDRANT_*``
123:     environment variables (see :mod:`headroom.memory.qdrant_env`). Passing an
124:     explicit value to the constructor always wins over the environment.
125:     """
126: 
127:     enabled: bool = False
128:     backend: Literal["local", "qdrant-neo4j"] = "local"
129:     db_path: str = "headroom_memory.db"
130:     inject_tools: bool = True
131:     inject_context: bool = True
132:     top_k: int = 10
133:     min_similarity: float = 0.3
134:     # Per-project storage routing (GH #462). When ``storage_mode`` is
135:     # PROJECT (default), each resolved workspace lands in its own SQLite
136:     # file under ``storage_root``; cross-project bleed becomes
137:     # structurally impossible. USER and GLOBAL preserve previous shapes
138:     # for users who explicitly opt back in.
139:     storage_mode: MemoryStorageMode = MemoryStorageMode.PROJECT
140:     storage_root: str = ""  # Defaults to dirname(db_path)/memories
141:     project_root_override: str = ""  # CLI ``--memory-project-root``
142:     # PR-B6: Memory injection mode. AUTO_TAIL (default) auto-appends retrieved
143:     # memory to the latest user message tail. TOOL disables auto-injection;
144:     # the model must call ``memory_search`` to retrieve. Configurable per
145:     # deployment via ``ProxyConfig.memory_mode``.
146:     mode: MemoryMode = MemoryMode.AUTO_TAIL
147:     # Native memory tool (Anthropic's built-in memory_20250818)
148:     use_native_tool: bool = False
149:     native_memory_dir: str = ""  # Directory for native memory files (default: ~/.headroom/memories)
150:     # Qdrant+Neo4j config (Qdrant defaults resolve from HEADROOM_QDRANT_* env vars)
151:     qdrant_url: str | None = field(default_factory=qdrant_env.qdrant_env_url)
152:     qdrant_host: str = field(default_factory=qdrant_env.qdrant_env_host)
153:     qdrant_port: int = field(default_factory=qdrant_env.qdrant_env_port)
154:     qdrant_api_key: str | None = field(default_factory=qdrant_env.qdrant_env_api_key)
155:     neo4j_uri: str = "neo4j://localhost:7687"
156:     neo4j_user: str = "neo4j"
157:     neo4j_password: str = field(default_factory=lambda: os.environ.get("NEO4J_PASSWORD", ""))
158:     # Memory Bridge (bidirectional markdown <-> Headroom sync)
159:     bridge_enabled: bool = False
160:     bridge_md_paths: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
161:     bridge_md_format: str = "auto"
162:     bridge_auto_import: bool = False
163:     bridge_export_path: str = ""
164: 
165: 
166: class MemoryHandler:
167:     """Unified handler for memory operations in the proxy.
168: 
169:     Responsibilities:
170:     1. Initialize and manage memory backend
171:     2. Inject memory tools into requests
172:     3. Search and inject relevant memories as context
173:     4. Handle memory tool calls in responses
174: 
175:     Supports two modes:
176:     - Custom tools: Headroom's memory_save, memory_search, etc. (default)
177:     - Native tool: Anthropic's memory_20250818 built-in tool (experimental)
178:     """
179: 
180:     # Cosine similarity thresholds for dedup
181:     DEDUP_AUTO_THRESHOLD = 0.92  # Auto-supersede (same fact, different wording)
182:     DEDUP_HINT_THRESHOLD = 0.75  # Suggest merge to LLM (related, possibly duplicate)
183: 
184:     def __init__(self, config: MemoryConfig, agent_type: str = "unknown") -> None:
185:         self.config = config
186:         self.agent_type = agent_type
187:         self._backend: LocalBackend | Any = None
188:         # Per-project routing for the local backend. Built in
189:         # ``_init_backend_locked`` so a single, shared resolver / LRU is
190:         # kept on the handler. Qdrant deployments use composite user-id
191:         # partitioning instead (see ``_compose_effective_user_id``) — the
192:         # router stays None in that case.
193:         self._router: BackendRouter | None = None
194:         self._initialized = False
195:         # Async singleflight guard for backend init. Ensures concurrent first
196:         # callers land on one init (double-checked pattern inside
197:         # _ensure_initialized). Not used by the legacy sync _initialized flag
198:         # on its own because that flag isn't atomic across await points.
199:         self._init_lock: asyncio.Lock | None = None
200:         self._memory_tools: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None
201:         # Native memory tool directory
202:         self._native_memory_dir: Path | None = None
203:         if config.use_native_tool:
204:             self._init_native_memory_dir()
205:         # Memory Bridge
206:         self._bridge: Any = None  # MemoryBridge, lazy imported
207: 
208:     def _get_init_lock(self) -> asyncio.Lock:
209:         """Lazily create the init lock bound to the running event loop.
210: 
211:         Avoids ``DeprecationWarning: There is no current event loop`` when
212:         ``MemoryHandler`` is constructed before the loop is set up.
213:         """
214:         if self._init_lock is None:
215:             self._init_lock = asyncio.Lock()
216:         return self._init_lock
217: 
218:     async def _close_backend_instance(self, backend: Any, *, reason: str) -> None:
219:         """Best-effort close for a partially initialized backend."""
220:         close = getattr(backend, "close", None)
221:         if not callable(close):
222:             return
223:         try:
224:             result = close()
225:             if inspect.isawaitable(result):
226:                 await result
227:         except Exception as exc:
228:             logger.warning(
229:                 "Memory: failed to close backend during %s cleanup: %s",
230:                 reason,
231:                 exc,
232:             )
233: 
234:     def _init_native_memory_dir(self) -> None:
235:         """Initialize native memory directory."""
236:         if self.config.native_memory_dir:
237:             self._native_memory_dir = Path(self.config.native_memory_dir)
238:         else:
239:             # Default: workspace memories directory (respects HEADROOM_WORKSPACE_DIR)
240:             from headroom import paths as _paths
241: 
242:             self._native_memory_dir = _paths.native_memory_dir()
243: 
244:         # Create directory if it doesn't exist
245:         self._native_memory_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
246:         logger.info(f"Memory: Native memory directory: {self._native_memory_dir}")
247: 
248:     def get_beta_headers(self) -> dict[str, str]:
249:         """Get beta headers required for native memory tool.
250: 
251:         Returns:
252:             Dict with beta headers to add to request, or empty dict.
253:         """
254:         if self.config.use_native_tool and self.config.inject_tools:
255:             return {"anthropic-beta": NATIVE_MEMORY_BETA_HEADER}
256:         return {}
257: 
258:     async def _ensure_initialized(self) -> None:
259:         """Lazy initialization of memory backend.
260: 
261:         Singleflight via ``self._init_lock`` with double-checked pattern:
262:         concurrent first callers await the same load rather than triggering
263:         N parallel backend inits. Wrapped in ``asyncio.wait_for`` with a
264:         configurable timeout (``STARTUP_INIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS``); on timeout
265:         ``self._initialized`` stays ``False`` so a later request can retry
266:         (fail-open contract — no exception propagates to request handlers).
267:         """
268:         # Fast path: already initialized, no lock contention.
269:         if self._initialized:
270:             return
271: 
272:         if not self.config.enabled:
273:             return
274: 
275:         lock = self._get_init_lock()
276: 
277:         async def _do_init() -> None:
278:             async with lock:
279:                 # Double-check after acquiring the lock — another task may
280:                 # have completed the init while we were waiting.
281:                 if self._initialized:
282:                     return
283:                 await self._init_backend_locked()
284: 
285:         try:
286:             await asyncio.wait_for(_do_init(), timeout=STARTUP_INIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
287:         except asyncio.TimeoutError:
288:             # Fail-open: leave _initialized=False so subsequent calls retry.
289:             # CRITICAL: also null the backend — _init_backend_locked may have
290:             # already assigned ``self._backend`` before its own await raised /
291:             # was cancelled by wait_for. Callers that do
292:             # ``if self.memory_handler._backend:`` must not see a
293:             # truthy-but-broken backend.
294:             existing_backend = self._backend
295:             if existing_backend is not None:
296:                 await self._close_backend_instance(existing_backend, reason="timeout")
297:             self._backend = None
298:             self._initialized = False
299:             logger.error(
300:                 "Memory: backend initialization timed out after "
301:                 f"{STARTUP_INIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}s "
302:                 f"(backend={self.config.backend}). "
303:                 "Subsequent requests will retry."
304:             )
305:             return
306:         except asyncio.CancelledError:
307:             # External cancellation (shutdown / task cancelled).
308:             # CancelledError is BaseException — the TimeoutError branch
309:             # above does NOT catch it, and caller ``except Exception``
310:             # blocks don't either, so it propagates unconditionally.
311:             # Reset state so any later retry starts clean, then re-raise:
312:             # cancellation is a signal, not an error to swallow.
313:             existing_backend = self._backend
314:             if existing_backend is not None:
315:                 await self._close_backend_instance(existing_backend, reason="cancellation")
316:             self._backend = None
317:             self._initialized = False
318:             logger.info(f"Memory: backend initialization cancelled (backend={self.config.backend})")
319:             raise
320: 
321:     async def _init_backend_locked(self) -> None:
322:         """Actual backend-init body. Must be called with ``_init_lock`` held."""
323:         if self.config.backend == "local":
324:             from headroom.memory.backends.local import LocalBackend, LocalBackendConfig
325: 
326:             # Auto-detect embedder: ONNX (default, ~86MB, no torch) → local (if torch available)
327:             embedder_backend = "onnx"
328:             embedder_model = "all-MiniLM-L6-v2"
329:             vector_dimension = 384
330: 
331:             # Opt-in GPU offload: HEADROOM_EMBEDDER_RUNTIME=pytorch_mps routes embedding
332:             # through the torch sentence-transformers backend on the Apple GPU (MPS).
333:             # LocalEmbedder serializes MPS encode calls (torch-MPS is not thread-safe).
334:             # We switch only when MPS is actually available; otherwise keep the
335:             # existing default embedder selection path (ONNX when available, then
336:             # the pre-existing local sentence-transformers fallback).
337:             if os.environ.get("HEADROOM_EMBEDDER_RUNTIME", "").strip().lower() == "pytorch_mps":
338:                 try:
339:                     import sentence_transformers  # noqa: F401
340:                     import torch
341: 
342:                     if torch.backends.mps.is_available():
343:                         embedder_backend = "local"
344:                         logger.info(
345:                             "Memory: HEADROOM_EMBEDDER_RUNTIME=pytorch_mps → "
346:                             "torch embedder on Apple GPU (MPS)"
347:                         )
348:                     else:
349:                         logger.warning(
350:                             "Memory: HEADROOM_EMBEDDER_RUNTIME=pytorch_mps requested but "
351:                             "MPS is not available; using default embedder selection"
352:                         )
353:                 except ImportError:
354:                     logger.warning(
355:                         "Memory: HEADROOM_EMBEDDER_RUNTIME=pytorch_mps requested but "
356:                         "torch/sentence-transformers not installed; using default embedder selection"
357:                     )
358: 
359:             # Check if ONNX runtime is available (should be — it's in proxy deps)
360:             if embedder_backend == "onnx":
361:                 try:
362:                     import onnxruntime  # noqa: F401
363:                 except ImportError:
364:                     # Fall back to sentence-transformers (requires torch)
365:                     embedder_backend = "local"
366:                     logger.info(
367:                         "Memory: onnxruntime not available, falling back to sentence-transformers"
368:                     )
369: 
370:             backend_config = LocalBackendConfig(
371:                 db_path=self.config.db_path,
372:                 embedder_backend=embedder_backend,
373:                 embedder_model=embedder_model,
374:                 vector_dimension=vector_dimension,
375:             )
376:             self._backend = LocalBackend(backend_config)
377:             await self._backend._ensure_initialized()
378:             logger.info(
379:                 f"Memory: Initialized LocalBackend at {self.config.db_path} "
380:                 f"(embedder: {embedder_backend})"
381:             )
382: 
383:             # Per-project routing (GH #462). The router shares the same
384:             # backend_config_template so every project DB inherits the
385:             # embedder / cache settings selected above. ``self._backend``
386:             # remains the GLOBAL-mode fallback / legacy compatibility
387:             # backend; callers that pass a ``RequestContext`` route
388:             # through ``self._router`` instead.
389:             storage_root = (
390:                 Path(self.config.storage_root)
391:                 if self.config.storage_root
392:                 else (Path(self.config.db_path).resolve().parent / "memories")
393:             )
394:             global_db_path = Path(self.config.db_path).resolve()
395:             router_cfg = BackendRouterConfig(
396:                 mode=self.config.storage_mode,
397:                 root_dir=storage_root,
398:                 global_db_path=global_db_path,
399:                 backend_config_template=backend_config,
400:             )
401:             self._router = BackendRouter(router_cfg)
402:             # Seed the router's LRU with the already-initialized
403:             # legacy backend so GLOBAL-mode requests reuse it instead
404:             # of opening a second handle to the same file.
405:             with self._router._lock:  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
406:                 self._router._backends[global_db_path] = self._backend  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
407:             logger.info(
408:                 "event=memory_router_initialized mode=%s root=%s global_db=%s",
409:                 self.config.storage_mode.value,
410:                 storage_root,
411:                 global_db_path,
412:             )
413: 
414:         elif self.config.backend == "qdrant-neo4j":
415:             try:
416:                 from headroom.memory.backends.direct_mem0 import (
417:                     DirectMem0Adapter,
418:                     Mem0Config,
419:                 )
420: 
421:                 mem0_config = Mem0Config(
422:                     qdrant_url=self.config.qdrant_url,
423:                     qdrant_host=self.config.qdrant_host,
424:                     qdrant_port=self.config.qdrant_port,
425:                     qdrant_api_key=self.config.qdrant_api_key,
426:                     neo4j_uri=self.config.neo4j_uri,
427:                     neo4j_user=self.config.neo4j_user,
428:                     neo4j_password=self.config.neo4j_password,
429:                     enable_graph=True,
430:                 )

433:                 qdrant_target = (

435:                 )
436:                 logger.info(f"Memory: Initialized Qdrant+Neo4j backend ({qdrant_target})")
437:             except ImportError as e:

478:         """Get memory tool definitions (cached)."""

485:     def compute_memory_tool_definitions(
486:         self,
487:         provider: str = "anthropic",
488:     ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
489:         """Return the memory tool definitions for ``provider`` (pure, no I/O).
490: 
491:         Replaces the building half of ``inject_tools`` so the proxy
492:         injection path can route through ``SessionToolTracker`` (PR-A7).
493:         Honors ``self.config.use_native_tool`` for Anthropic so the
494:         native ``memory_20250818`` tool flows through the same sticky
495:         codepath as the custom ``memory_save`` / ``memory_search`` set.
496: 
497:         The returned list is a fresh list of dicts. Order is stable
498:         (matches ``_get_memory_tools()`` order) so the canonical bytes
499:         are deterministic across calls.
500:         """
501:         if not self.config.inject_tools:
502:             return []
503: 
504:         if self.config.use_native_tool and provider == "anthropic":
505:             return [
506:                 {
507:                     "type": NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_TYPE,
508:                     "name": NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_NAME,
509:                 }
510:             ]
511: 
512:         out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
513:         for memory_tool in self._get_memory_tools():
514:             tool_name = memory_tool["function"]["name"]
515:             if provider == "anthropic":
516:                 out.append(
517:                     {
518:                         "name": tool_name,
519:                         "description": memory_tool["function"]["description"],
520:                         "input_schema": memory_tool["function"]["parameters"],
521:                     }
522:                 )
523:             else:
524:                 # OpenAI format — return a fresh shallow copy so callers
525:                 # can mutate without surprise. dict() is sufficient: the
526:                 # nested schema is treated as immutable downstream.
527:                 out.append(dict(memory_tool))
528:         return out
529: 
530:     def inject_tools(
531:         self,
532:         tools: list[dict[str, Any]] | None,
533:         provider: str = "anthropic",
534:     ) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], bool]:
535:         """Inject memory tools into tools list.
536: 
537:         Args:
538:             tools: Existing tools list (may be None).
539:             provider: Provider for tool format ("anthropic" or "openai").
540: 
541:         Returns:
542:             Tuple of (updated_tools, was_injected).
543: 
544:         NOTE (PR-A7): The proxy now wires injection through
545:         ``apply_session_sticky_memory_tools`` so tool list bytes stay
546:         cache-stable across turns. This method remains as the
547:         non-session-aware fallback for tests / callers that don't have
548:         a session_id (e.g. diagnostic shadow runs).
549:         """
550:         if not self.config.inject_tools:
551:             return tools or [], False
552: 
553:         tools = list(tools) if tools else []
554: 
555:         # Use native memory tool if configured
556:         if self.config.use_native_tool:
557:             return self._inject_native_tool(tools)
558: 
559:         # Check which tools are already present
560:         existing_names: set[str] = set()
561:         for tool in tools:
562:             name = tool.get("name") or (tool.get("function") or {}).get("name")
563:             if name:
564:                 existing_names.add(name)
565: 
566:         # Add missing memory tools
567:         was_injected = False
568:         for memory_tool in self._get_memory_tools():
569:             tool_name = memory_tool["function"]["name"]
570:             if tool_name in existing_names:
571:                 continue
572: 
573:             # Convert to provider format
574:             if provider == "anthropic":
575:                 tools.append(
576:                     {
577:                         "name": tool_name,
578:                         "description": memory_tool["function"]["description"],
579:                         "input_schema": memory_tool["function"]["parameters"],
580:                     }
581:                 )
582:             else:
583:                 # OpenAI format
584:                 tools.append(memory_tool)
585: 
586:             was_injected = True
587: 
588:         return tools, was_injected
589: 
590:     def _inject_native_tool(self, tools: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], bool]:
591:         """Inject Anthropic's native memory tool (memory_20250818).
592: 
593:         This uses Anthropic's built-in memory tool format which may be
594:         allowed by Claude Code subscription credentials (unlike custom tools).
595: 
596:         Returns:
597:             Tuple of (updated_tools, was_injected).
598:         """
599:         # Check if native memory tool already present
600:         for tool in tools:
601:             if tool.get("type") == NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_TYPE:
602:                 return tools, False
603:             if tool.get("name") == NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_NAME:
604:                 return tools, False
605: 
606:         # Add native memory tool
607:         native_tool = {
608:             "type": NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_TYPE,
609:             "name": NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_NAME,
610:         }
611:         tools.append(native_tool)
612: 
613:         logger.info(
614:             f"Memory: Injected native memory tool ({NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_TYPE}). "
615:             f"Beta header required: {NATIVE_MEMORY_BETA_HEADER}"
616:         )
617:         return tools, True

619:     def _resolve_for_request(
620:         self, base_user_id: str, request_context: RequestContext | None
621:     ) -> tuple[Any, ResolvedScope | None, str]:
622:         """Pick the backend + effective user_id for a single request.
623: 
624:         Returns ``(backend, scope, effective_user_id)``. ``scope`` is
625:         ``None`` when the caller did not provide a ``RequestContext``
626:         (e.g. legacy tests, qdrant deployments that pre-date the router)
627:         — in that case the legacy ``self._backend`` and the bare
628:         ``base_user_id`` are returned, matching pre-fix behaviour.
629: 
630:         For the local backend with a ``RequestContext`` the router picks
631:         the project DB; the user_id passed into the backend stays the
632:         raw user_id (physical isolation is the partition).
633: 
634:         For the qdrant-neo4j backend a composite ``user_id::project_key``
635:         is used so projects partition logically inside the single
636:         Qdrant collection. The router does not own qdrant connections.
637:         """
638: 
639:         if request_context is None or self._router is None:
640:             return self._backend, None, base_user_id
641: 
642:         if self.config.backend == "local":
643:             backend, scope = self._router.backend_for(request_context)
644:             return backend, scope, base_user_id
645: 
646:         # Non-local backends: derive scope but keep one shared backend
647:         # and compose the user_id so the partition lives in the user_id
648:         # column instead of in a separate file.
649:         scope = self._router._resolve_scope(request_context)
650:         composed = (
651:             base_user_id
652:             if scope.project_key is None or scope.mode is MemoryStorageMode.GLOBAL
653:             else f"{base_user_id}::{scope.project_key}"
654:         )
655:         return self._backend, scope, composed
656: 
657:     @staticmethod
658:     def _format_memory_block_header(scope: ResolvedScope | None) -> str:
659:         """Workspace / scope provenance header for the injected memory block.
660: 
661:         Fix C from GH #462: the previous header (``## Relevant Memories for
662:         This User``) had no scope information, so a model receiving cross-
663:         project leakage could not reason about whether the memories
664:         applied — Claude flagged the block as prompt injection. Including
665:         the workspace name and scope mode makes the provenance visible.
666:         """
667: 
668:         if scope is None:
669:             return "## Relevant Memories for This User"
670:         if scope.mode is MemoryStorageMode.PROJECT:
671:             return f"## Relevant Memories (workspace: {scope.display_name}, scope: project)"
672:         if scope.mode is MemoryStorageMode.USER:
673:             return f"## Relevant Memories (user: {scope.display_name}, scope: user)"
674:         return "## Relevant Memories (scope: global)"
675: 
676:     async def search_and_format_context(
677:         self,
678:         user_id: str,
679:         messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
680:         request_context: RequestContext | None = None,
681:         *,
682:         ranker: Any | None = None,
683:         query: Any | None = None,
684:         budget: Any | None = None,
685:     ) -> str | None:
686:         """Search memories and format as context injection.
687: 
688:         Args:
689:             user_id: User identifier for memory scoping (the base user
690:                 id, derived from ``x-headroom-user-id`` upstream).
691:             messages: Conversation messages (used to extract query when
692:                 ``query`` is not provided).
693:             request_context: Optional request envelope (headers, system
694:                 prompt, base user id). When provided, memory retrieval
695:                 is scoped to the resolved workspace / project so memories
696:                 from unrelated projects can never bleed in (GH #462). When
697:                 omitted, behaves as before this fix — single-bucket search
698:                 against the legacy backend. Production handlers always
699:                 pass it; tests / mocks can keep the simpler call shape.
700:             ranker: Optional :class:`~headroom.proxy.memory_ranker.MemoryRanker`
701:                 — re-ranks the backend's cosine-only candidates by an
702:                 additional signal (recency, source, access count, …).
703:                 When ``None`` (default), behaviour is pure cosine +
704:                 ``budget.min_similarity`` floor. When provided, candidates
705:                 are adapted to :class:`MemoryCandidate`, re-ranked, then
706:                 re-filtered by ``budget.min_similarity`` on the boosted
707:                 score.
708:             query: Optional :class:`MemoryQuery` — multi-source, full-
709:                 fidelity retrieval query. When provided, takes precedence
710:                 over the ``messages``-derived query. Constructed at the
711:                 handler from latest user msg + recent tool outputs +
712:                 recent assistant turns; preserves full input fidelity (no
713:                 500-char truncation).
714:             budget: Optional :class:`MemoryInjectionBudget` — bounds the
715:                 returned formatted block by tokens / entries / min
716:                 similarity. When ``None``, defaults are taken from
717:                 ``self.config`` so the existing top_k / min_similarity
718:                 contract is preserved. Both the no-ranker and the with-
719:                 ranker paths honour the same budget.
720: 
721:         Returns:
722:             Formatted context string, or None if no relevant memories.
723: 
724:         PR-B6: When ``self.config.mode == MemoryMode.TOOL``, this method
725:         returns ``None`` unconditionally so the proxy never auto-injects.
726:         The model must call ``memory_search`` explicitly to retrieve.
727:         """
728:         from headroom.proxy.memory_injection import MemoryInjectionBudget
729: 
730:         if not self.config.inject_context:
731:             return None
732: 
733:         # PR-B6: Tool mode disables auto-injection. The model calls
734:         # ``memory_search`` to retrieve when it wants to.
735:         if self.config.mode == MemoryMode.TOOL:
736:             logger.info(
737:                 "event=memory_mode_skip mode=tool user_id=%s reason=tool_mode_no_auto_injection",
738:                 user_id,
739:             )
740:             return None
741: 
742:         await self._ensure_initialized()
743:         if not self._backend:
744:             return None
745: 
746:         backend, scope, effective_user_id = self._resolve_for_request(user_id, request_context)
747: 
748:         # Fail-closed when the router was unable to resolve a project in
749:         # PROJECT mode and `unresolved_project_fallback="empty"` (the
750:         # default after the 2026-05-26 incident). The sentinel signal is
751:         # `mode=PROJECT` + `project_key=None`: project mode was requested
752:         # but no x-headroom-project-id / x-headroom-cwd / system-prompt
753:         # cwd: was available, so we have no idea which project this
754:         # request belongs to. Returning None here skips injection
755:         # entirely — better than pooling into GLOBAL and surfacing
756:         # memories from unrelated past sessions (the TAM-550 imperative-
757:         # misread bug).
758:         if (
759:             scope is not None
760:             and scope.mode is MemoryStorageMode.PROJECT
761:             and scope.project_key is None
762:         ):
763:             logger.info(
764:                 "event=memory_inject_skipped reason=project_unresolved user_id=%s scope_display=%s",
765:                 effective_user_id,
766:                 scope.display_name,
767:             )
768:             return None
769: 
770:         # Build the embedding query. When the handler provides a
771:         # MemoryQuery, use its multi-source untruncated input; otherwise
772:         # fall back to extracting from messages (kept for legacy callers
773:         # / tests). Full fidelity in both paths.
774:         if query is not None:
775:             query_text = query.to_embedding_input()
776:         else:
777:             query_text = self._extract_user_query(messages)
778:         if not query_text:
779:             logger.debug("Memory: No query text for context search")
780:             return None
781: 
782:         # Compose the budget: explicit per-call wins; otherwise derive
783:         # from self.config so existing top_k/min_similarity callers see
784:         # no behaviour change.
785:         effective_budget = (
786:             budget
787:             if budget is not None
788:             else MemoryInjectionBudget(
789:                 max_entries=self.config.top_k,
790:                 min_similarity=self.config.min_similarity,
791:             )
792:         )
793: 
794:         try:
795:             # Search memories on the per-request resolved backend.
796:             results = await backend.search_memories(
797:                 query=query_text,
798:                 user_id=effective_user_id,
799:                 top_k=effective_budget.max_entries,
800:                 include_related=True,
801:             )
802: 
803:             if not results:
804:                 logger.debug(
805:                     "Memory: No memories found for user=%s scope=%s",
806:                     effective_user_id,
807:                     scope.display_name if scope else "<legacy>",
808:                 )
809:                 return None
810: 
811:             # Optional re-rank: when a MemoryRanker is provided, adapt
812:             # results to MemoryCandidate, re-rank, then filter by
813:             # ``budget.min_similarity`` on the BOOSTED score. The re-rank
814:             # can promote a fresh weak-cosine memory above a stale
815:             # strong-cosine one (RecencyBoostRanker default behaviour).
816:             # Cap by ``budget.max_entries`` after filtering so the budget
817:             # contract is honoured on both branches.
818:             # Each rendered row carries the memory ID in [brackets] so
819:             # the model can address it directly via memory_update /
820:             # memory_delete without round-tripping through memory_search.
821:             # Both branches below render the same `i. [id] content` shape
822:             # so the format is stable regardless of whether a ranker is
823:             # in play.
824:             selected_memory_ids: list[str] = []
825:             if ranker is not None:
826:                 from headroom.proxy.memory_ranker import MemoryCandidate
827: 
828:                 candidates = [MemoryCandidate.from_backend_result(r) for r in results]
829:                 ranked = ranker.rank(candidates)
830:                 # Filter on the post-rank score (the ranker may have
831:                 # boosted or attenuated original cosine values).
832:                 ranked = [c for c in ranked if c.score >= effective_budget.min_similarity]
833:                 if not ranked:
834:                     logger.debug(
835:                         f"Memory: {len(results)} memories found but none above threshold "
836:                         f"{effective_budget.min_similarity} after re-rank"
837:                     )
838:                     return None
839:                 ranked = ranked[: effective_budget.max_entries]
840:                 memory_lines = []

1304:     async def _background_dedup(
1305:         self,
1306:         new_memory_id: str,
1307:         similar_results: list[Any],
1308:         user_id: str,
1309:         backend: Any | None = None,
1310:     ) -> None:
1311:         """Auto-supersede obvious duplicates in background (fire-and-forget).
1312: 
1313:         If an existing memory has >0.92 cosine similarity to the new one,
1314:         mark the older one as superseded. This runs asynchronously and
1315:         never blocks the tool response.
1316: 
1317:         ``backend`` defaults to the legacy ``self._backend`` so existing
1318:         non-routed callers keep working; routed callers pass the same
1319:         per-project backend they wrote to so dedup never crosses
1320:         workspaces.
1321:         """
1322:         target = backend if backend is not None else self._backend
1323:         if target is None:
1324:             return
1325:         try:
1326:             for result in similar_results:
1327:                 if result.score < self.DEDUP_AUTO_THRESHOLD:

1: """Memory integration handler for the proxy server.
2: 
3: This module provides memory capabilities for the Headroom proxy:
4: 1. MemoryHandler - Unified handler for memory operations
5:    - inject_tools() - Add memory tools to requests
6:    - search_and_format_context() - Search memories, format for injection
7:    - has_memory_tool_calls() - Detect memory tool usage in response
8:    - handle_memory_tool_calls() - Execute tools, return results
9: 
10: Usage:
11:     config = MemoryConfig(enabled=True, backend="local")
12:     handler = MemoryHandler(config)
13: 
14:     # Inject tools into request
15:     tools, was_injected = handler.inject_tools(existing_tools, "anthropic")
16: 
17:     # Search and inject context
18:     context = await handler.search_and_format_context(user_id, messages)
19: 
20:     # Handle tool calls in response
21:     if handler.has_memory_tool_calls(response, "anthropic"):
22:         results = await handler.handle_memory_tool_calls(response, user_id, "anthropic")
23: """
24: 
25: from __future__ import annotations
26: 
27: import asyncio
28: import enum
29: import inspect
30: import json
31: import logging
32: import os
33: from dataclasses import dataclass, field
34: from datetime import datetime, timezone
35: from pathlib import Path
36: from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Literal

38: from headroom.memory import qdrant_env
39: from headroom.memory.storage_router import (
40:     BackendRouter,
41:     BackendRouterConfig,
42:     MemoryStorageMode,
43:     RequestContext,
44:     ResolvedScope,
45: )

47: if TYPE_CHECKING:
48:     from headroom.memory.backends.local import LocalBackend

50: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

53: class MemoryMode(str, enum.Enum):
54:     """Memory injection mode (PR-B6).
55: 
56:     AUTO_TAIL (default): Memory retrieval runs at request entry; results are
57:     appended to the latest user message tail (the live zone). The cache hot
58:     zone (system prompt / instructions / frozen prefix) is never mutated —
59:     invariant I2 from PR-A2.
60: 
61:     TOOL: Auto-injection is disabled entirely. The model calls the
62:     ``memory_search`` tool explicitly when it wants memory; retrieval runs in
63:     the tool execution path, not the prompt-construction path. Memory becomes
64:     opt-in (and visible to the model) rather than implicit.
65: 
66:     See REALIGNMENT/04-phase-B-live-zone.md PR-B6 for the rationale.
67:     """
68: 
69:     AUTO_TAIL = "auto_tail"
70:     TOOL = "tool"
71: 
72: 
73: # Memory tool names for detection (Headroom's custom tools)
74: MEMORY_TOOL_NAMES = {
75:     "memory_save",
76:     "memory_search",
77:     "memory_update",
78:     "memory_delete",
79:     "memory_list",
80: }
81: 
82: # Anthropic's native memory tool name
83: NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_NAME = "memory"
84: 
85: # Beta header required for native memory tool
86: NATIVE_MEMORY_BETA_HEADER = "context-management-2025-06-27"
87: 
88: # Native memory tool type
89: NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_TYPE = "memory_20250818"
90: 
91: # Maximum time to wait for a single backend initialization (one-shot).
92: # Applies to MemoryHandler._ensure_initialized. On timeout, _initialized
93: # stays False so that subsequent requests retry instead of deadlocking.
94: # See wiki/plans/2026-04-17-fix-codex-proxy-resilience-plan.md "Risks" row 7.
95: STARTUP_INIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30.0
96: 
97: 
98: def _serialize_created_at(value: Any) -> str | None:
99:     """Best-effort timestamp serialization for tool-result payloads.
100: 
101:     The backend may return ``datetime`` (from a freshly-saved row) or
102:     string (from a hydrated SQLite row). Either way the model needs
103:     a string to render in chat. Unparseable values → None.
104:     """
105:     if value is None:
106:         return None
107:     if isinstance(value, str):
108:         return value
109:     if hasattr(value, "isoformat"):
110:         try:
111:             iso = value.isoformat()
112:             return iso if isinstance(iso, str) else str(iso)
113:         except Exception:
114:             return str(value)
115:     return str(value)

119: class MemoryConfig:
120:     """Configuration for memory handler.
121: 
122:     Qdrant connection fields default to values read from ``HEADROOM_QDRANT_*``
123:     environment variables (see :mod:`headroom.memory.qdrant_env`). Passing an
124:     explicit value to the constructor always wins over the environment.
125:     """
126: 
127:     enabled: bool = False
128:     backend: Literal["local", "qdrant-neo4j"] = "local"
129:     db_path: str = "headroom_memory.db"
130:     inject_tools: bool = True
131:     inject_context: bool = True
132:     top_k: int = 10
133:     min_similarity: float = 0.3
134:     # Per-project storage routing (GH #462). When ``storage_mode`` is
135:     # PROJECT (default), each resolved workspace lands in its own SQLite
136:     # file under ``storage_root``; cross-project bleed becomes
137:     # structurally impossible. USER and GLOBAL preserve previous shapes
138:     # for users who explicitly opt back in.
139:     storage_mode: MemoryStorageMode = MemoryStorageMode.PROJECT
140:     storage_root: str = ""  # Defaults to dirname(db_path)/memories
141:     project_root_override: str = ""  # CLI ``--memory-project-root``
142:     # PR-B6: Memory injection mode. AUTO_TAIL (default) auto-appends retrieved
143:     # memory to the latest user message tail. TOOL disables auto-injection;
144:     # the model must call ``memory_search`` to retrieve. Configurable per
145:     # deployment via ``ProxyConfig.memory_mode``.
146:     mode: MemoryMode = MemoryMode.AUTO_TAIL
147:     # Native memory tool (Anthropic's built-in memory_20250818)
148:     use_native_tool: bool = False
149:     native_memory_dir: str = ""  # Directory for native memory files (default: ~/.headroom/memories)
150:     # Qdrant+Neo4j config (Qdrant defaults resolve from HEADROOM_QDRANT_* env vars)
151:     qdrant_url: str | None = field(default_factory=qdrant_env.qdrant_env_url)
152:     qdrant_host: str = field(default_factory=qdrant_env.qdrant_env_host)
153:     qdrant_port: int = field(default_factory=qdrant_env.qdrant_env_port)
154:     qdrant_api_key: str | None = field(default_factory=qdrant_env.qdrant_env_api_key)
155:     neo4j_uri: str = "neo4j://localhost:7687"
156:     neo4j_user: str = "neo4j"
157:     neo4j_password: str = field(default_factory=lambda: os.environ.get("NEO4J_PASSWORD", ""))
158:     # Memory Bridge (bidirectional markdown <-> Headroom sync)
159:     bridge_enabled: bool = False
160:     bridge_md_paths: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
161:     bridge_md_format: str = "auto"
162:     bridge_auto_import: bool = False
163:     bridge_export_path: str = ""

165: 
166: class MemoryHandler:
167:     """Unified handler for memory operations in the proxy.
168: 
169:     Responsibilities:
170:     1. Initialize and manage memory backend
171:     2. Inject memory tools into requests
172:     3. Search and inject relevant memories as context
173:     4. Handle memory tool calls in responses
174: 
175:     Supports two modes:
176:     - Custom tools: Headroom's memory_save, memory_search, etc. (default)
177:     - Native tool: Anthropic's memory_20250818 built-in tool (experimental)
178:     """
179: 
180:     # Cosine similarity thresholds for dedup
181:     DEDUP_AUTO_THRESHOLD = 0.92  # Auto-supersede (same fact, different wording)
182:     DEDUP_HINT_THRESHOLD = 0.75  # Suggest merge to LLM (related, possibly duplicate)
183: 
184:     def __init__(self, config: MemoryConfig, agent_type: str = "unknown") -> None:
185:         self.config = config
186:         self.agent_type = agent_type
187:         self._backend: LocalBackend | Any = None
188:         # Per-project routing for the local backend. Built in
189:         # ``_init_backend_locked`` so a single, shared resolver / LRU is
190:         # kept on the handler. Qdrant deployments use composite user-id
191:         # partitioning instead (see ``_compose_effective_user_id``) — the
192:         # router stays None in that case.
193:         self._router: BackendRouter | None = None
194:         self._initialized = False
195:         # Async singleflight guard for backend init. Ensures concurrent first
196:         # callers land on one init (double-checked pattern inside
197:         # _ensure_initialized). Not used by the legacy sync _initialized flag
198:         # on its own because that flag isn't atomic across await points.
199:         self._init_lock: asyncio.Lock | None = None
200:         self._memory_tools: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None
201:         # Native memory tool directory
202:         self._native_memory_dir: Path | None = None
203:         if config.use_native_tool:
204:             self._init_native_memory_dir()
205:         # Memory Bridge
206:         self._bridge: Any = None  # MemoryBridge, lazy imported
207: 
208:     def _get_init_lock(self) -> asyncio.Lock:
209:         """Lazily create the init lock bound to the running event loop.
210: 
211:         Avoids ``DeprecationWarning: There is no current event loop`` when
212:         ``MemoryHandler`` is constructed before the loop is set up.
213:         """
214:         if self._init_lock is None:
215:             self._init_lock = asyncio.Lock()
216:         return self._init_lock
217: 
218:     async def _close_backend_instance(self, backend: Any, *, reason: str) -> None:
219:         """Best-effort close for a partially initialized backend."""
220:         close = getattr(backend, "close", None)
221:         if not callable(close):
222:             return
223:         try:
224:             result = close()
225:             if inspect.isawaitable(result):
226:                 await result
227:         except Exception as exc:
228:             logger.warning(
229:                 "Memory: failed to close backend during %s cleanup: %s",
230:                 reason,
231:                 exc,
232:             )
233: 
234:     def _init_native_memory_dir(self) -> None:
235:         """Initialize native memory directory."""
236:         if self.config.native_memory_dir:
237:             self._native_memory_dir = Path(self.config.native_memory_dir)
238:         else:
239:             # Default: workspace memories directory (respects HEADROOM_WORKSPACE_DIR)
240:             from headroom import paths as _paths
241: 
242:             self._native_memory_dir = _paths.native_memory_dir()
243: 
244:         # Create directory if it doesn't exist
245:         self._native_memory_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
246:         logger.info(f"Memory: Native memory directory: {self._native_memory_dir}")
247: 
248:     def get_beta_headers(self) -> dict[str, str]:
249:         """Get beta headers required for native memory tool.
250: 
251:         Returns:
252:             Dict with beta headers to add to request, or empty dict.
253:         """
254:         if self.config.use_native_tool and self.config.inject_tools:
255:             return {"anthropic-beta": NATIVE_MEMORY_BETA_HEADER}
256:         return {}
257: 
258:     async def _ensure_initialized(self) -> None:
259:         """Lazy initialization of memory backend.
260: 
261:         Singleflight via ``self._init_lock`` with double-checked pattern:
262:         concurrent first callers await the same load rather than triggering
263:         N parallel backend inits. Wrapped in ``asyncio.wait_for`` with a
264:         configurable timeout (``STARTUP_INIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS``); on timeout
265:         ``self._initialized`` stays ``False`` so a later request can retry
266:         (fail-open contract — no exception propagates to request handlers).
267:         """
268:         # Fast path: already initialized, no lock contention.
269:         if self._initialized:
270:             return
271: 
272:         if not self.config.enabled:
273:             return
274: 
275:         lock = self._get_init_lock()
276: 
277:         async def _do_init() -> None:
278:             async with lock:
279:                 # Double-check after acquiring the lock — another task may
280:                 # have completed the init while we were waiting.
281:                 if self._initialized:
282:                     return
283:                 await self._init_backend_locked()
284: 
285:         try:
286:             await asyncio.wait_for(_do_init(), timeout=STARTUP_INIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
287:         except asyncio.TimeoutError:
288:             # Fail-open: leave _initialized=False so subsequent calls retry.
289:             # CRITICAL: also null the backend — _init_backend_locked may have
290:             # already assigned ``self._backend`` before its own await raised /
291:             # was cancelled by wait_for. Callers that do
292:             # ``if self.memory_handler._backend:`` must not see a
293:             # truthy-but-broken backend.
294:             existing_backend = self._backend
295:             if existing_backend is not None:
296:                 await self._close_backend_instance(existing_backend, reason="timeout")
297:             self._backend = None
298:             self._initialized = False
299:             logger.error(
300:                 "Memory: backend initialization timed out after "
301:                 f"{STARTUP_INIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}s "
302:                 f"(backend={self.config.backend}). "
303:                 "Subsequent requests will retry."
304:             )
305:             return
306:         except asyncio.CancelledError:
307:             # External cancellation (shutdown / task cancelled).
308:             # CancelledError is BaseException — the TimeoutError branch
309:             # above does NOT catch it, and caller ``except Exception``
310:             # blocks don't either, so it propagates unconditionally.

312:             # cancellation is a signal, not an error to swallow.
313:             existing_backend = self._backend
314:             if existing_backend is not None:
315:                 await self._close_backend_instance(existing_backend, reason="cancellation")
316:             self._backend = None
317:             self._initialized = False
318:             logger.info(f"Memory: backend initialization cancelled (backend={self.config.backend})")
319:             raise

485:     def compute_memory_tool_definitions(
486:         self,
487:         provider: str = "anthropic",
488:     ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
489:         """Return the memory tool definitions for ``provider`` (pure, no I/O).
490: 
491:         Replaces the building half of ``inject_tools`` so the proxy
492:         injection path can route through ``SessionToolTracker`` (PR-A7).
493:         Honors ``self.config.use_native_tool`` for Anthropic so the
494:         native ``memory_20250818`` tool flows through the same sticky
495:         codepath as the custom ``memory_save`` / ``memory_search`` set.
496: 
497:         The returned list is a fresh list of dicts. Order is stable
498:         (matches ``_get_memory_tools()`` order) so the canonical bytes
499:         are deterministic across calls.
500:         """
501:         if not self.config.inject_tools:
502:             return []
503: 
504:         if self.config.use_native_tool and provider == "anthropic":
505:             return [
506:                 {
507:                     "type": NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_TYPE,
508:                     "name": NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_NAME,
509:                 }
510:             ]
511: 
512:         out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
513:         for memory_tool in self._get_memory_tools():
514:             tool_name = memory_tool["function"]["name"]
515:             if provider == "anthropic":
516:                 out.append(
517:                     {
518:                         "name": tool_name,
519:                         "description": memory_tool["function"]["description"],
520:                         "input_schema": memory_tool["function"]["parameters"],
521:                     }
522:                 )
523:             else:
524:                 # OpenAI format — return a fresh shallow copy so callers
525:                 # can mutate without surprise. dict() is sufficient: the
526:                 # nested schema is treated as immutable downstream.
527:                 out.append(dict(memory_tool))
528:         return out
529: 
530:     def inject_tools(
531:         self,
532:         tools: list[dict[str, Any]] | None,
533:         provider: str = "anthropic",
534:     ) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], bool]:
535:         """Inject memory tools into tools list.
536: 
537:         Args:
538:             tools: Existing tools list (may be None).
539:             provider: Provider for tool format ("anthropic" or "openai").
540: 
541:         Returns:
542:             Tuple of (updated_tools, was_injected).
543: 
544:         NOTE (PR-A7): The proxy now wires injection through
545:         ``apply_session_sticky_memory_tools`` so tool list bytes stay
546:         cache-stable across turns. This method remains as the
547:         non-session-aware fallback for tests / callers that don't have
548:         a session_id (e.g. diagnostic shadow runs).
549:         """
550:         if not self.config.inject_tools:
551:             return tools or [], False
552: 
553:         tools = list(tools) if tools else []
554: 
555:         # Use native memory tool if configured
556:         if self.config.use_native_tool:
557:             return self._inject_native_tool(tools)
558: 
559:         # Check which tools are already present
560:         existing_names: set[str] = set()
561:         for tool in tools:
562:             name = tool.get("name") or (tool.get("function") or {}).get("name")
563:             if name:
564:                 existing_names.add(name)
565: 
566:         # Add missing memory tools
567:         was_injected = False
568:         for memory_tool in self._get_memory_tools():
569:             tool_name = memory_tool["function"]["name"]
570:             if tool_name in existing_names:
571:                 continue
572: 
573:             # Convert to provider format
574:             if provider == "anthropic":
575:                 tools.append(
576:                     {
577:                         "name": tool_name,
578:                         "description": memory_tool["function"]["description"],
579:                         "input_schema": memory_tool["function"]["parameters"],
580:                     }
581:                 )
582:             else:
583:                 # OpenAI format
584:                 tools.append(memory_tool)
585: 
586:             was_injected = True
587: 
588:         return tools, was_injected
589: 
590:     def _inject_native_tool(self, tools: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], bool]:
591:         """Inject Anthropic's native memory tool (memory_20250818).
592: 
593:         This uses Anthropic's built-in memory tool format which may be
594:         allowed by Claude Code subscription credentials (unlike custom tools).
595: 
596:         Returns:
597:             Tuple of (updated_tools, was_injected).
598:         """
599:         # Check if native memory tool already present
600:         for tool in tools:
601:             if tool.get("type") == NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_TYPE:
602:                 return tools, False
603:             if tool.get("name") == NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_NAME:
604:                 return tools, False
605: 
606:         # Add native memory tool
607:         native_tool = {
608:             "type": NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_TYPE,
609:             "name": NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_NAME,
610:         }
611:         tools.append(native_tool)
612: 
613:         logger.info(
614:             f"Memory: Injected native memory tool ({NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_TYPE}). "
615:             f"Beta header required: {NATIVE_MEMORY_BETA_HEADER}"
616:         )
617:         return tools, True

619:     def _resolve_for_request(
620:         self, base_user_id: str, request_context: RequestContext | None
621:     ) -> tuple[Any, ResolvedScope | None, str]:
622:         """Pick the backend + effective user_id for a single request.
623: 
624:         Returns ``(backend, scope, effective_user_id)``. ``scope`` is
625:         ``None`` when the caller did not provide a ``RequestContext``
626:         (e.g. legacy tests, qdrant deployments that pre-date the router)
627:         — in that case the legacy ``self._backend`` and the bare
628:         ``base_user_id`` are returned, matching pre-fix behaviour.
629: 
630:         For the local backend with a ``RequestContext`` the router picks
631:         the project DB; the user_id passed into the backend stays the
632:         raw user_id (physical isolation is the partition).
633: 
634:         For the qdrant-neo4j backend a composite ``user_id::project_key``
635:         is used so projects partition logically inside the single
636:         Qdrant collection. The router does not own qdrant connections.
637:         """
638: 
639:         if request_context is None or self._router is None:
640:             return self._backend, None, base_user_id
641: 
642:         if self.config.backend == "local":
643:             backend, scope = self._router.backend_for(request_context)
644:             return backend, scope, base_user_id
645: 
646:         # Non-local backends: derive scope but keep one shared backend
647:         # and compose the user_id so the partition lives in the user_id
648:         # column instead of in a separate file.
649:         scope = self._router._resolve_scope(request_context)
650:         composed = (
651:             base_user_id
652:             if scope.project_key is None or scope.mode is MemoryStorageMode.GLOBAL
653:             else f"{base_user_id}::{scope.project_key}"
654:         )
655:         return self._backend, scope, composed
656: 
657:     @staticmethod
658:     def _format_memory_block_header(scope: ResolvedScope | None) -> str:
659:         """Workspace / scope provenance header for the injected memory block.
660: 
661:         Fix C from GH #462: the previous header (``## Relevant Memories for
662:         This User``) had no scope information, so a model receiving cross-
663:         project leakage could not reason about whether the memories
664:         applied — Claude flagged the block as prompt injection. Including
665:         the workspace name and scope mode makes the provenance visible.
666:         """
667: 
668:         if scope is None:
669:             return "## Relevant Memories for This User"
670:         if scope.mode is MemoryStorageMode.PROJECT:
671:             return f"## Relevant Memories (workspace: {scope.display_name}, scope: project)"
672:         if scope.mode is MemoryStorageMode.USER:
673:             return f"## Relevant Memories (user: {scope.display_name}, scope: user)"
674:         return "## Relevant Memories (scope: global)"
675: 
676:     async def search_and_format_context(
677:         self,
678:         user_id: str,
679:         messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
680:         request_context: RequestContext | None = None,
681:         *,
682:         ranker: Any | None = None,
683:         query: Any | None = None,
684:         budget: Any | None = None,
685:     ) -> str | None:
686:         """Search memories and format as context injection.
687: 
688:         Args:
689:             user_id: User identifier for memory scoping (the base user
690:                 id, derived from ``x-headroom-user-id`` upstream).
691:             messages: Conversation messages (used to extract query when
692:                 ``query`` is not provided).
693:             request_context: Optional request envelope (headers, system
694:                 prompt, base user id). When provided, memory retrieval
695:                 is scoped to the resolved workspace / project so memories
696:                 from unrelated projects can never bleed in (GH #462). When
697:                 omitted, behaves as before this fix — single-bucket search
698:                 against the legacy backend. Production handlers always
699:                 pass it; tests / mocks can keep the simpler call shape.
700:             ranker: Optional :class:`~headroom.proxy.memory_ranker.MemoryRanker`
701:                 — re-ranks the backend's cosine-only candidates by an
702:                 additional signal (recency, source, access count, …).
703:                 When ``None`` (default), behaviour is pure cosine +
704:                 ``budget.min_similarity`` floor. When provided, candidates
705:                 are adapted to :class:`MemoryCandidate`, re-ranked, then
706:                 re-filtered by ``budget.min_similarity`` on the boosted
707:                 score.
708:             query: Optional :class:`MemoryQuery` — multi-source, full-
709:                 fidelity retrieval query. When provided, takes precedence
710:                 over the ``messages``-derived query. Constructed at the
711:                 handler from latest user msg + recent tool outputs +
712:                 recent assistant turns; preserves full input fidelity (no
713:                 500-char truncation).
714:             budget: Optional :class:`MemoryInjectionBudget` — bounds the
715:                 returned formatted block by tokens / entries / min
716:                 similarity. When ``None``, defaults are taken from
717:                 ``self.config`` so the existing top_k / min_similarity
718:                 contract is preserved. Both the no-ranker and the with-
719:                 ranker paths honour the same budget.
720: 
721:         Returns:
722:             Formatted context string, or None if no relevant memories.
723: 
724:         PR-B6: When ``self.config.mode == MemoryMode.TOOL``, this method
725:         returns ``None`` unconditionally so the proxy never auto-injects.
726:         The model must call ``memory_search`` explicitly to retrieve.
727:         """
728:         from headroom.proxy.memory_injection import MemoryInjectionBudget
729: 
730:         if not self.config.inject_context:
731:             return None
732: 
733:         # PR-B6: Tool mode disables auto-injection. The model calls
734:         # ``memory_search`` to retrieve when it wants to.
735:         if self.config.mode == MemoryMode.TOOL:
736:             logger.info(
737:                 "event=memory_mode_skip mode=tool user_id=%s reason=tool_mode_no_auto_injection",
738:                 user_id,
739:             )
740:             return None
741: 
742:         await self._ensure_initialized()
743:         if not self._backend:
744:             return None
745: 
746:         backend, scope, effective_user_id = self._resolve_for_request(user_id, request_context)
747: 
748:         # Fail-closed when the router was unable to resolve a project in
749:         # PROJECT mode and `unresolved_project_fallback="empty"` (the
750:         # default after the 2026-05-26 incident). The sentinel signal is
751:         # `mode=PROJECT` + `project_key=None`: project mode was requested
752:         # but no x-headroom-project-id / x-headroom-cwd / system-prompt
753:         # cwd: was available, so we have no idea which project this
754:         # request belongs to. Returning None here skips injection
755:         # entirely — better than pooling into GLOBAL and surfacing
756:         # memories from unrelated past sessions (the TAM-550 imperative-
757:         # misread bug).
758:         if (
759:             scope is not None
760:             and scope.mode is MemoryStorageMode.PROJECT
761:             and scope.project_key is None
762:         ):
763:             logger.info(
764:                 "event=memory_inject_skipped reason=project_unresolved user_id=%s scope_display=%s",
765:                 effective_user_id,
766:                 scope.display_name,
767:             )
768:             return None
769: 
770:         # Build the embedding query. When the handler provides a
771:         # MemoryQuery, use its multi-source untruncated input; otherwise
772:         # fall back to extracting from messages (kept for legacy callers
773:         # / tests). Full fidelity in both paths.
774:         if query is not None:
775:             query_text = query.to_embedding_input()
776:         else:
777:             query_text = self._extract_user_query(messages)
778:         if not query_text:
779:             logger.debug("Memory: No query text for context search")
780:             return None
781: 
782:         # Compose the budget: explicit per-call wins; otherwise derive
783:         # from self.config so existing top_k/min_similarity callers see
784:         # no behaviour change.
785:         effective_budget = (
786:             budget
787:             if budget is not None
788:             else MemoryInjectionBudget(
789:                 max_entries=self.config.top_k,
790:                 min_similarity=self.config.min_similarity,
791:             )
792:         )
793: 
794:         try:
795:             # Search memories on the per-request resolved backend.
796:             results = await backend.search_memories(
797:                 query=query_text,
798:                 user_id=effective_user_id,
799:                 top_k=effective_budget.max_entries,
800:                 include_related=True,
801:             )
802: 
803:             if not results:
804:                 logger.debug(
805:                     "Memory: No memories found for user=%s scope=%s",
806:                     effective_user_id,
807:                     scope.display_name if scope else "<legacy>",
808:                 )
809:                 return None
810: 
811:             # Optional re-rank: when a MemoryRanker is provided, adapt
812:             # results to MemoryCandidate, re-rank, then filter by
813:             # ``budget.min_similarity`` on the BOOSTED score. The re-rank
814:             # can promote a fresh weak-cosine memory above a stale
815:             # strong-cosine one (RecencyBoostRanker default behaviour).
816:             # Cap by ``budget.max_entries`` after filtering so the budget
817:             # contract is honoured on both branches.
818:             # Each rendered row carries the memory ID in [brackets] so
819:             # the model can address it directly via memory_update /
820:             # memory_delete without round-tripping through memory_search.
821:             # Both branches below render the same `i. [id] content` shape
822:             # so the format is stable regardless of whether a ranker is
823:             # in play.
824:             selected_memory_ids: list[str] = []
825:             if ranker is not None:
826:                 from headroom.proxy.memory_ranker import MemoryCandidate
827: 
828:                 candidates = [MemoryCandidate.from_backend_result(r) for r in results]
829:                 ranked = ranker.rank(candidates)
830:                 # Filter on the post-rank score (the ranker may have
831:                 # boosted or attenuated original cosine values).
832:                 ranked = [c for c in ranked if c.score >= effective_budget.min_similarity]
833:                 if not ranked:
834:                     logger.debug(
835:                         f"Memory: {len(results)} memories found but none above threshold "
836:                         f"{effective_budget.min_similarity} after re-rank"
837:                     )
838:                     return None
839:                 ranked = ranked[: effective_budget.max_entries]
840:                 memory_lines = []
841:                 for i, candidate in enumerate(ranked, 1):
842:                     memory_id = candidate.id or "?"
843:                     if candidate.id:
844:                         selected_memory_ids.append(candidate.id)
845:                     memory_lines.append(f"{i}. [{memory_id}] {candidate.content}")
846:                     if candidate.related_entities:
847:                         entities_str = ", ".join(candidate.related_entities[:3])
848:                         memory_lines.append(f"   (Related: {entities_str})")
849:             else:
850:                 # No ranker: pure cosine + budget min_similarity floor.
851:                 filtered_results = [
852:                     r for r in results if r.score >= effective_budget.min_similarity
853:                 ]
854: 
855:                 if not filtered_results:
856:                     logger.debug(
857:                         f"Memory: {len(results)} memories found but none above threshold "
858:                         f"{effective_budget.min_similarity}"
859:                     )
860:                     return None
861: 
862:                 # Cap entry count via the budget (defence-in-depth —
863:                 # backend already gets top_k=max_entries but this enforces
864:                 # it on post-filter results too).
865:                 filtered_results = filtered_results[: effective_budget.max_entries]
866: 
867:                 memory_lines = []
868:                 for i, result in enumerate(filtered_results, 1):
869:                     memory_id = getattr(result.memory, "id", None) or "?"
870:                     if memory_id != "?":
871:                         selected_memory_ids.append(memory_id)
872:                     memory_lines.append(f"{i}. [{memory_id}] {result.memory.content}")
873:                     if hasattr(result, "related_entities") and result.related_entities:
874:                         entities_str = ", ".join(result.related_entities[:3])
875:                         memory_lines.append(f"   (Related: {entities_str})")
876: 
877:         except Exception as e:

1304:     async def _background_dedup(
1305:         self,
1306:         new_memory_id: str,
1307:         similar_results: list[Any],
1308:         user_id: str,
1309:         backend: Any | None = None,
1310:     ) -> None:
1311:         """Auto-supersede obvious duplicates in background (fire-and-forget).
1312: 
1313:         If an existing memory has >0.92 cosine similarity to the new one,
1314:         mark the older one as superseded. This runs asynchronously and
1315:         never blocks the tool response.
1316: 
1317:         ``backend`` defaults to the legacy ``self._backend`` so existing
1318:         non-routed callers keep working; routed callers pass the same
1319:         per-project backend they wrote to so dedup never crosses
1320:         workspaces.
1321:         """
1322:         target = backend if backend is not None else self._backend
1323:         if target is None:
1324:             return
1325:         try:
1326:             for result in similar_results:
1327:                 if result.score < self.DEDUP_AUTO_THRESHOLD:

1: """Memory integration handler for the proxy server.
2: 
3: This module provides memory capabilities for the Headroom proxy:
4: 1. MemoryHandler - Unified handler for memory operations
5:    - inject_tools() - Add memory tools to requests
6:    - search_and_format_context() - Search memories, format for injection
7:    - has_memory_tool_calls() - Detect memory tool usage in response
8:    - handle_memory_tool_calls() - Execute tools, return results
9: 
10: Usage:
11:     config = MemoryConfig(enabled=True, backend="local")
12:     handler = MemoryHandler(config)
13: 
14:     # Inject tools into request
15:     tools, was_injected = handler.inject_tools(existing_tools, "anthropic")
16: 
17:     # Search and inject context
18:     context = await handler.search_and_format_context(user_id, messages)
19: 
20:     # Handle tool calls in response
21:     if handler.has_memory_tool_calls(response, "anthropic"):
22:         results = await handler.handle_memory_tool_calls(response, user_id, "anthropic")
23: """
24: 
25: from __future__ import annotations
26: 
27: import asyncio
28: import enum
29: import inspect
30: import json
31: import logging
32: import os
33: from dataclasses import dataclass, field
34: from datetime import datetime, timezone
35: from pathlib import Path
36: from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Literal
37: 
38: from headroom.memory import qdrant_env
39: from headroom.memory.storage_router import (
40:     BackendRouter,
41:     BackendRouterConfig,
42:     MemoryStorageMode,
43:     RequestContext,
44:     ResolvedScope,
45: )
46: 
47: if TYPE_CHECKING:
48:     from headroom.memory.backends.local import LocalBackend
49: 
50: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
51:

53: class MemoryMode(str, enum.Enum):
54:     """Memory injection mode (PR-B6).
55: 
56:     AUTO_TAIL (default): Memory retrieval runs at request entry; results are
57:     appended to the latest user message tail (the live zone). The cache hot
58:     zone (system prompt / instructions / frozen prefix) is never mutated —
59:     invariant I2 from PR-A2.
60: 
61:     TOOL: Auto-injection is disabled entirely. The model calls the
62:     ``memory_search`` tool explicitly when it wants memory; retrieval runs in
63:     the tool execution path, not the prompt-construction path. Memory becomes
64:     opt-in (and visible to the model) rather than implicit.
65: 
66:     See REALIGNMENT/04-phase-B-live-zone.md PR-B6 for the rationale.
67:     """
68: 
69:     AUTO_TAIL = "auto_tail"
70:     TOOL = "tool"
71: 
72: 
73: # Memory tool names for detection (Headroom's custom tools)
74: MEMORY_TOOL_NAMES = {
75:     "memory_save",
76:     "memory_search",
77:     "memory_update",
78:     "memory_delete",
79:     "memory_list",
80: }
81: 
82: # Anthropic's native memory tool name
83: NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_NAME = "memory"
84: 
85: # Beta header required for native memory tool
86: NATIVE_MEMORY_BETA_HEADER = "context-management-2025-06-27"
87: 
88: # Native memory tool type
89: NATIVE_MEMORY_TOOL_TYPE = "memory_20250818"
90: 
91: # Maximum time to wait for a single backend initialization (one-shot).
92: # Applies to MemoryHandler._ensure_initialized. On timeout, _initialized
93: # stays False so that subsequent requests retry instead of deadlocking.
94: # See wiki/plans/2026-04-17-fix-codex-proxy-resilience-plan.md "Risks" row 7.
95: STARTUP_INIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30.0
96: 
97: 
98: def _serialize_created_at(value: Any) -> str | None:
99:     """Best-effort timestamp serialization for tool-result payloads.
100: 
101:     The backend may return ``datetime`` (from a freshly-saved row) or
102:     string (from a hydrated SQLite row). Either way the model needs
103:     a string to render in chat. Unparseable values → None.
104:     """
105:     if value is None:
106:         return None
107:     if isinstance(value, str):
108:         return value
109:     if hasattr(value, "isoformat"):
110:         try:
111:             iso = value.isoformat()
112:             return iso if isinstance(iso, str) else str(iso)
113:         except Exception:
114:             return str(value)
115:     return str(value)

119: class MemoryConfig:
120:     """Configuration for memory handler.
121: 
122:     Qdrant connection fields default to values read from ``HEADROOM_QDRANT_*``
123:     environment variables (see :mod:`headroom.memory.qdrant_env`). Passing an
124:     explicit value to the constructor always wins over the environment.
125:     """
126: 
127:     enabled: bool = False
128:     backend: Literal["local", "qdrant-neo4j"] = "local"
129:     db_path: str = "headroom_memory.db"
130:     inject_tools: bool = True
131:     inject_context: bool = True
132:     top_k: int = 10
133:     min_similarity: float = 0.3
134:     # Per-project storage routing (GH #462). When ``storage_mode`` is
135:     # PROJECT (default), each resolved workspace lands in its own SQLite
136:     # file under ``storage_root``; cross-project bleed becomes
137:     # structurally impossible. USER and GLOBAL preserve previous shapes
138:     # for users who explicitly opt back in.
139:     storage_mode: MemoryStorageMode = MemoryStorageMode.PROJECT
140:     storage_root: str = ""  # Defaults to dirname(db_path)/memories
141:     project_root_override: str = ""  # CLI ``--memory-project-root``
142:     # PR-B6: Memory injection mode. AUTO_TAIL (default) auto-appends retrieved
143:     # memory to the latest user message tail. TOOL disables auto-injection;
144:     # the model must call ``memory_search`` to retrieve. Configurable per
145:     # deployment via ``ProxyConfig.memory_mode``.
146:     mode: MemoryMode = MemoryMode.AUTO_TAIL
147:     # Native memory tool (Anthropic's built-in memory_20250818)
148:     use_native_tool: bool = False
149:     native_memory_dir: str = ""  # Directory for native memory files (default: ~/.headroom/memories)
150:     # Qdrant+Neo4j config (Qdrant defaults resolve from HEADROOM_QDRANT_* env vars)
151:     qdrant_url: str | None = field(default_factory=qdrant_env.qdrant_env_url)
152:     qdrant_host: str = field(default_factory=qdrant_env.qdrant_env_host)
153:     qdrant_port: int = field(default_factory=qdrant_env.qdrant_env_port)
154:     qdrant_api_key: str | None = field(default_factory=qdrant_env.qdrant_env_api_key)
155:     neo4j_uri: str = "neo4j://localhost:7687"
156:     neo4j_user: str = "neo4j"
157:     neo4j_password: str = field(default_factory=lambda: os.environ.get("NEO4J_PASSWORD", ""))
158:     # Memory Bridge (bidirectional markdown <-> Headroom sync)
159:     bridge_enabled: bool = False
160:     bridge_md_paths: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
161:     bridge_md_format: str = "auto"
162:     bridge_auto_import: bool = False
163:     bridge_export_path: str = ""
